articles.title: Atea Pharmaceuticals Strengthens Management Team with Appointment of Clinical and Regulatory Leadership

articles.summary: Atea Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the discovery and development of next-generation therapeutics for severe human viral infections, today announced the appointment of Janet Hammond, M.D., Ph.D., Sc.M., F.C.P., to the newly-created position of Chief Development Officer. Dr. Hammond will be responsible for overseeing Atea’s clinical development programs, specifically spearheading its development of AT-527 for the treatment of COVID-19.
articles.title: Atea Pharmaceuticals Appoints Janet Hammond, M.D., Ph.D., as Chief Development Officer
